note: Backend-agnostic generator registry. asset_kind tags each backend as serving the bgm or video lane so the router can filter by lane (same split as the bgm/tts lanes). Adding a sound/video source = one entry here; the router + generate_loop never change. status mirrors tts-evaluations engine status (active | pending | archived_failed) so a credit-exhausted backend (like fish was) is auto-excluded from routing.
